restaurantName: Yong Kee Claypot Bak Kut Teh

bio: Pork rib soup is served in a claypot alongside other condiments, such as peppercorns. The Chinese herbal version strikes a fine balance, with distinctive yet not overpowering herbal flavours. Other claypot soups are also available....
